## Why This Is Asked

Assesses end-to-end GCP ML workflow design for streaming IoT data, practical use of Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Storage, Vertex AI, canary deployment, and drift/latency monitoring with a rollback plan. Emphasizes beginner-friendly sequencing and real-world constraints.

## Key Concepts

- Pub/Sub streaming ingestion for high-throughput data
- Dataflow enrichment with per-device metadata
- Cloud Storage for raw and processed artifacts
- Vertex AI weekly training and canary deployment
- Cloud Monitoring for drift/latency metrics
- Simple rollback strategy and data provenance
- Cost control via staged training and quota awareness

## Code Example

```python
def is_drift(new_mean, base_mean, base_std, thresh=0.1):
    diff = abs(new_mean - base_mean) / max(base_std, 1e-6)
    return diff > thresh
```

- How would you implement a rolling rollback window to avoid sudden traffic shifts?
- Which metrics would you surface in dashboards to detect model degradation early?
